article.story: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. -- — Caleb Sanders had 20 points in Tennessee Tech’s 97-69 win against Presbyterian on Saturday. Sanders shot 6 of 12 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 9 from the free-throw line for the Golden Eagles (5-2). Kamai Samuels scored 15 points while shooting 7 for 13, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc. Shaun Arnold finished 5 of 7 from the field to finish with 13 points, while adding five rebounds and three steals. Jaylen Peterson led the Blue Hose (1-4) with 21 points. Carl Parrish added 12 points and eight rebounds for Presbyterian. Khalon Hudson also had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
